//extends: A RELATIVE path, and the only one in the workspace. DesignSystem.md §2.4 puts the Tailwind preset re-export in packages/config, which makes config depend on ui. If ui also declared @gymmap/config, turbo would refuse the whole task graph: `@gymmap/ui#build -> @gymmap/config#build -> @gymmap/ui#build`. The dependency broken here is the weaker of the two — a build-time tsconfig convenience, versus a normative file location — and it costs one relative path in one file.
//include: `tailwind-preset.ts` and `test/` are included deliberately. The preset is real code that three apps depend on — leaving it out of the project meant a type error in it surfaced only when an app built, which is the slowest possible place to find one. It caught two on the first run.
